baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unrestricted upper-and-lower-domain construction at words 3-8, followed by the three exclusive possession clauses at words 9-17.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper and lower realms exhaust the spatial field; every knowable entity within it performs worship and clears God of defect, while sovereignty, commendation, and effective capacity converge in one possessor.

activation_trace.role: Worshipful glorification is the literal contribution and supplies the universal liturgical action.
Clearing God of defect is the literal contribution and makes the action a cosmic verdict about transcendence.
What rises and overshadows is the literal contribution and establishes the upper pole of the total field.
The low realm opposite the sky is the literal contribution and closes the field at its lower pole.
Kingship and public authority are the literal contribution and place the whole field under one rule.
Praise opposed to blame is the literal contribution and qualifies that rule as commendable.
Comprehensive inclusion of all parts is the literal contribution and blocks an exception to the final capacity claim.
Anything knowable and reportable is the literal contribution and makes each entity an object of the capacity claim.
Effective ability to act and possess is the literal contribution and supplies the governing efficacy.

changed_reading.after: Every knowable entity across both spatial poles enacts worship and transcendence within one praiseworthy, effective sovereignty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 1 read together with the rule-and-capacity sequence at words 10-17.
baseline_models.mechanism: The swimming and running branch makes praise kinetic. The branches of cohesion, exact measure, and deliberate arrangement then make ordered motion rather than mere sound the mechanism by which the cosmos praises.

activation_trace.role: Running or swimming through a medium is the literal contribution and renders cosmic praise as sustained motion.
Strength and cohesion are the literal contribution and keep many motions from dissolving into disorder.
A quantity reaching its proper limit is the literal contribution and gives each motion a bounded course.
Deliberate estimation and fitting are the literal contribution and supply the ordering intelligence behind the courses.

changed_reading.before: Praise is chiefly an utterance attributed to the cosmos.
changed_reading.after: The cosmos praises by moving in held, measured courses; its coordinated activity is itself doxological.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel exclusive clauses joining rule and praise at words 9-12, completed by measured capacity at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Parallel possession joins authority to praise rather than leaving praise as an unrelated response. Tested commendability, a praiseworthy endpoint, and fitted arrangement make the quality and outcome of rule part of the focus claim.

activation_trace.role: Possession with power of disposal is the literal contribution and defines rule as accountable handling of what is possessed.
Finding something commendable after experience is the literal contribution and makes praise responsive to manifest quality.
A commendable endpoint is the literal contribution and gives governance a praised terminus.
Fitting a thing to its due measure is the literal contribution and links power to proportion rather than excess.

changed_reading.before: God owns rule and separately receives acclaim.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents a rule whose fitted exercise and reached outcomes are themselves found worthy of praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is immediately followed by opposed human responses. The covering branch allows conscious refusal to obscure a testimony that created existence still performs, so universal praise and moral dissent occupy different layers rather than canceling each other.

activation_trace.role: Clearing God of defect is the literal contribution and defines the testimony carried by creaturely existence.
Bringing creation into existence is the literal contribution and places both human parties inside the created totality.
Obscuring truth is the literal contribution and explains dissent as covering rather than escaping the cosmic field.
Heart-settling assent is the literal contribution and marks conscious agreement with the testimony.

structural_cues: 64:2 places opposed human stances inside the population just created, directly after the focus's unrestricted upper-and-lower totalization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation plus opposed assent and covering; I infer an involuntary creaturely disclosure beneath voluntary response. A live alternative is that the focus totalization is rhetorical or excludes morally refusing humans.

changed_reading.before: Universal praise implies unanimous conscious devotion.
changed_reading.after: Creaturely existence can testify universally while human agents consciously disclose or cover that same testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's capacity is unfolded as measuring creation, giving it reality-matched form, and knowing both concealed and manifest states. Power therefore appears as exact formation plus complete disclosure, not as undirected force.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate estimation and fitting are the literal contribution and seed the measured reading of capacity.
Measuring a thing before or in making it is the literal contribution and turns creation into calibrated production.
Stable correspondence with reality is the literal contribution and gives the created order a non-arbitrary standard.
Form and formed configuration are the literal contribution and make capacity visible in fitted embodiments.
A thing becoming uncovered to the knower is the literal contribution and supplies exhaustive cognitive access.
Concealment in the interior is the literal contribution and supplies the hidden side of what power comprehends.
Open manifestation is the literal contribution and completes the concealed-manifest pair.

structural_cues: 64:3-4 unfolds a sequence from creating, through forming and return, to knowledge of inner and outer states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, form, truth-correspondence, and disclosure; I connect them as modes of the focus capacity. They may instead be adjacent examples rather than a definition of that capacity.

changed_reading.before: Capacity means unrestricted ability in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: Capacity is displayed as calibrated making, reality-matched form, and access to every concealed and manifest state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refusal and turning away are juxtaposed with divine self-sufficiency and continued praiseworthiness. Cosmic praise is therefore not tribute that supplies a lack or keeps sovereignty intact; it recognizes a quality unaffected by reception.

activation_trace.role: Praise as the opposite of blame is the literal contribution and supplies the acclaim whose dependence is tested.
Covering truth is the literal contribution and supplies explicit non-recognition.
Turning one's back is the literal contribution and intensifies non-recognition into withdrawal.
Independence from need is the literal contribution and breaks any causal dependence on creaturely acclaim.
Being richly endowed with commendable qualities is the literal contribution and preserves praiseworthiness after refusal.

structural_cues: 64:6 ends the rejection sequence by pairing self-sufficiency with praiseworthiness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal followed by self-sufficiency and praise; I infer that praise recognizes rather than sustains divine rule. Alternatively, the closing attributes may console without analyzing the economy of praise.

changed_reading.before: The cosmos supplies praise to its ruler.
changed_reading.after: Praise belongs to God even where agents withhold it; universal glorification is recognition, not needed tribute.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rousing what is still, gathering what is dispersed, exposing loss, and assigning a destination turn the focus capacity into a temporal mechanism of reassembly and audit. Sovereignty reaches beyond present order to recover agents and settle trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Effective ability is the literal contribution and supplies the capacity later exercised across time.
Stirring the still from rest is the literal contribution and gives capacity a reactivation mechanism.
Joining dispersed parts into a collected whole is the literal contribution and makes sovereignty recover every agent.
Loss through an inequitable exchange is the literal contribution and turns gathering into disclosure of real value.
Becoming toward an endpoint is the literal contribution and closes the audit with an assigned trajectory.

structural_cues: 64:7-10 moves from denial of reactivation, through emphatic reporting and gathering, to contrasted durable outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reactivation, collection, exposed loss, and destination; I connect them as an audit enacted by sovereignty. A live alternative is that these are only examples of capacity, not its governing purpose.

changed_reading.before: Power maintains the currently visible cosmos.
changed_reading.after: Power also reactivates, reassembles, audits, and carries every agent to an outcome beyond the present order.

context_deltas.mechanism: An adverse event is figured as an occurrence that lands under authorization, while guidance turns the inner center. The focus capacity therefore includes governing occurrence and reorienting response, not simply preventing every painful event.

activation_trace.role: Effective ability is the literal contribution and supplies the broad claim that this context qualifies.
Aiming and striking a target are the literal contribution and make affliction a located event rather than undifferentiated chaos.
Authorization is the literal contribution and places occurrence within allowed governance without itself specifying direct causation.
Gentle direction toward a way is the literal contribution and gives power an inward orienting action.
The inner heart is the literal contribution and locates the changed response inside the affected person.
Turning a thing from one face to another is the latent contribution and renders heart-guidance as reorientation.

structural_cues: 64:11 repeats the focus's totality formula after placing authorized affliction and guided interior response side by side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impact, permission, and heart-guidance; I infer a sequence from governed occurrence to governed response. Permission may mean allowance rather than active production, and heart-guidance may be consolation rather than causal compensation.

changed_reading.before: Power over everything should mean the removal of every adverse occurrence.
changed_reading.after: Power can govern what is allowed to occur and redirect the heart within it, without being reduced to prevention.

context_deltas.mechanism: A real domestic threat is met by alertness, then a graded release of retaliation: leaving punishment, turning the page, covering injury, and mercy. The focus pairing of rule with praise is thus socially refracted as power that can refrain, repair, and release rather than imitate hostility.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign authority is the literal contribution and supplies the power whose praiseworthy mode is being tested.
A commendable endpoint is the literal contribution and makes repaired relation, not domination, the valued terminus.
Wakeful guarding against danger is the literal contribution and prevents clemency from becoming naivety.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault are the literal contribution and initiate the release of retaliatory control.
Turning away beautifully from an offense is the literal contribution and shifts power from fixation to relational release.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer from consequence is the literal contribution and supplies reparative restraint.
Tender mercy is the literal contribution and names the affective quality completing the release sequence.

structural_cues: 64:14 acknowledges threat before ordering a three-step clemency sequence and closing with mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies danger, guardedness, release, covering, and mercy; I read this as an enacted analogue of praiseworthy rule. It may instead be a local family ethic with no intended model of sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: Praiseworthy sovereignty is mainly superior control.
changed_reading.after: Its social analogue is alert but non-retaliatory power that can leave punishment, turn the page, cover injury, and restore relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human assets become a test between withholding and outflow. Expenditure and a cut-out loan are returned multiplied, while divine appreciation makes a little gift visibly consequential. The focus ownership is therefore non-scarcity sovereignty that relativizes human possession into stewardship and circulation.

activation_trace.role: Possession with disposal is the literal contribution and supplies the ownership claim that later human possessives complicate.
Praise for beneficence is the literal contribution and links sovereignty's resource flow to gratitude.
Acquiring and accumulating wealth are the literal contribution and supply the human counterclaim of possession.
Testing metal or persons is the literal contribution and makes possession an assay of its holder.
Wealth leaving the hand in expenditure is the literal contribution and starts the circulation mechanism.
Greedy withholding is the literal contribution and identifies the blockage opposed to circulation.
Cutting out wealth or work so its recompense returns is the literal contribution and frames giving as trustful transfer.
Increasing a thing by its like is the literal contribution and makes divine return exceed scarcity logic.
Making a small amount suffice and show its effect is the literal contribution and gives praise a responsive, amplifying side.

structural_cues: 64:14-16 repeatedly calls family and wealth 'yours', then 64:17 startlingly recasts transfer to the true owner as a loan that returns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possession, testing, outflow, withholding, loan, increase, and appreciative response; I infer stewardship under non-scarcity ownership. The loan may be exhortative metaphor rather than a full ontology of property.

changed_reading.before: Divine ownership and human wealth are separate facts.
changed_reading.after: Divine ownership turns human having into tested stewardship: what leaves a possessive grip enters a praised circulation and returns enlarged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence gives power total epistemic range, overcoming force, and a wisdom branch whose core is restraint for repair and exact construction. Capacity over every thing is thereby qualified from inside: irresistible efficacy is neither blind nor arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Effective ability is the literal contribution and supplies the force qualified by the closing attributes.
Complete disclosure to the knower is the literal contribution and gives force informed reach.
What is screened from sight is the literal contribution and extends informed reach beyond visibility.
Presence with observation is the literal contribution and completes the hidden-present range.
Overcoming dominance is the literal contribution and sharpens capacity into irresistible efficacy.
Restraint and redirection for repair are the literal contribution and prevent efficacy from becoming arbitrary excess.
Exact construction and secure workmanship are the literal contribution and make wise power precise.

structural_cues: 64:18 closes the surah by pairing hidden-present knowledge with overcoming force and wisdom, echoing the focus's final capacity clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-located knowledge, dominance, restraint, and exactness; I read the latter qualities as governing how force operates. They could instead be parallel attributes without a logical constraint relation.

changed_reading.before: Capacity over everything could be heard as sheer unconstrained force.
changed_reading.after: Capacity is all-seeing and overcoming, yet internally directed by reparative restraint and exact workmanship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the focus motion branch through descending illumination, running water, and an event that lands. It remains anchored in the focus verb and its upper-lower field, but downstream prose should label it a cross-material flow analogy rather than a lexical paraphrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The motion-capable focus verb at word 1 spanning the upper and lower domains at words 5 and 8.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or running through a medium is the literal contribution and supplies the focus's flow anchor.
Illumination is the literal contribution and supplies what becomes transmissible through the cosmic field.
Descent and arrival are the literal contribution and give the flow a vertical vector.
Continuous running is the literal contribution and extends the flow horizontally.
A watercourse cutting through earth is the literal contribution and gives the flow a durable channel.
Rain descending from above and settling is the branch contribution and makes even adverse arrival resemble material flow.

changed_reading.before: The cosmos praises while remaining a static container.
changed_reading.after: The upper-lower cosmos can be carried as a circulation in which illumination descends, waters run, events land, and ordered flow performs praise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a non-dominant mapped inventory beneath the focus's sky-root and overlays it with later signs and witness-marks. The packet mapping and focus word keep it anchored, but it should be rendered only as a split-root visual overlay, never as the focus word's settled derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sky-word at index 5 under its packet-supplied non-dominant mapped target, coordinated with the motion verb at index 1.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark is the literal contribution and recasts the upper realm as a readable marked surface.
Running motion is the literal contribution and makes the marks dynamic rather than static.
A distinguishing trace that guides recognition is the literal contribution and makes cosmic marking legible.
A manifest sign is the literal contribution and supplies the context's explicit sign-function.
A mark that bears witness is the literal contribution and closes the overlay as visible testimony.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only the upper location containing praisers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper field is a moving, marked register whose signs themselves bear witness and praise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus ownership root's remote image of water by which travelers secure their affairs, then joins it to rivers and expenditure. It remains anchored directly at the focus ownership word, but prose should present it as a material analogy for sustaining governance, not as the primary sense of kingship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ownership word at index 10, using its packet-supplied provisioning branch.

activation_trace.role: Water that lets travelers secure their affairs is the literal contribution and recasts rule as life-sustaining provision.
Cohesion and support are the literal contribution and turn provision into the infrastructure of held order.
A flowing channel cut through earth is the literal contribution and materializes provision as maintained circulation.
Resources going out in expenditure are the literal contribution and translate hydraulic flow into social circulation.
A transferred portion whose recompense returns is the literal contribution and gives provisioning flow a return path.

changed_reading.before: Sovereignty is pictured primarily as throne-like possession.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sovereignty is the provisioning infrastructure that holds life by keeping water, wealth, and return in circulation.

strongest_changes: Universal praise split into creaturely testimony and variable conscious response rather than forced unanimity.
Capacity became calibrated formation, disclosure, reassembly, audit, and inward reorientation rather than abstract force.
Praise proved independent of creaturely tribute because refusal is followed by self-sufficient praiseworthiness.
Ownership became non-scarcity stewardship in which tested possessions circulate and return enlarged.
The closing knowledge, dominance, restraint, and exactness qualified power as wise rather than arbitrary.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several live mechanisms at once: liturgy, coordinated motion, praiseworthy governance, non-dependent praise, reparative restraint, and a resource-return economy. The most fragile but productive activations were the split-root marked cosmos and the material analogies of cosmic and provisioning flow.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the universal subject entails ontological praise by morally refusing humans or functions rhetorically around them.
Whether the parallel rule-and-praise clauses logically qualify one another or simply state two possessions.
Whether authorization of adversity implies production, allowance, or only inclusion within knowledge and rule.
How much interpretive weight downstream prose should give the motion, marking, and water-provision branches beyond exploratory overlays.
